privacy: Dataset aliases and aggregate measurements only. Production paths, images, camera arrays and exported object/element identities are omitted. Original local reports remain ignored; hashes support a local audit.

measurement_definition.window: Real GNOME/Mutter output; native GTK4 window and Gtk.GLArea; actual NVIDIA OpenGL context. No Xvfb or EGL pbuffer.
measurement_definition.protocol: Same tool SHA and 94-frame protocol; 12 measured samples plus 2 warmups for resident, orbit, pan, dolly and resident playback; 4 native intervals, streaming playback and 5 exact picks.
measurement_definition.source_camera: Same compatible source camera/view and native time for before/after; exact numerical equality verified, arrays omitted.
measurement_definition.cpu_prepare: Read-only SceneDocument.prepare_frame on one background worker; calibration preparation recorded separately.
measurement_definition.cpu_submission: Normal product viewport render callback CPU wall time, including upload/sort submission.
measurement_definition.gpu_elapsed: Asynchronous GL_TIME_ELAPSED for sort/render. Under shared GPU scheduling this is elapsed device timeline, not isolated shader-cycle cost.
measurement_definition.gl_completion_wall: One request in flight; nonblocking GL fence after normal GLArea render. Includes event-loop/poll scheduling; excludes later GTK/compositor/desktop presentation.
measurement_definition.combined_latency: CPU preparation plus calibration preparation plus queued GL completion wall, kept separate from GPU-only elapsed.
measurement_definition.exact_pick: pick_blocking_wall_ms includes the production GPU projection/readback and CPU identity reduction. In exact_pick phase, gpu_ms describes the subsequent selection-feedback render, not an isolated pick GPU timer.
measurement_definition.memory: Linux process RSS/high-water mark includes NumPy/mmap/driver allocations. Declared GPU resident bytes are renderer estimates, not total device VRAM.
measurement_definition.cold: First process operation only; OS page cache is uncontrolled. Source validation is not cold-storage throughput.

gpu_load.observation: Before/after each AFTER process; existing workloads were neither stopped nor changed.
gpu_load.limitation: These are contended, shared-GPU measurements. Before/after GPU elapsed or completion wall-time differences cannot be attributed causally to product changes; no isolated-device throughput or desktop presentation FPS is claimed.

baseline_harness_attempt_excluded: One initial attempt was aborted before any GPU sample because a true-handled signal suppressed an after-handler. It contributes no timings to these profiles; the corrected identical tool observes the unchanged product render path through a local subclass and has an independent watchdog.
